An Interesting Festival

一个有趣的节日 · 199 词 · 4 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1The Agricultural Feast takes place after Independence Day. It is not a worldwide celebration. Only Christians in Mexico look forward to its arrival because of its religious origins.

2Long ago, humans’ ancestors were bad. They fooled and played tricks on each other and never kept their word. So God appeared, flooded their fields and destroyed all their crops. The people starved and wept day and night. In order to gain God’s forgiveness, a woman poet set off to see God. She told God how much she admired him and kept apologising. God was moved. With his permission, humans finally had good harvests again. So, to put their sadness behind them and remind themselves of their belief in God, people began the festival.

3During the festival, people gather in the open air at places such as playgrounds or parking lots and celebrate together all night long, as though they were never tired. When a woman dressed in lovely clothing reads poems in memory of the poet, everyone holds their breath. Then, it is the custom that a bone from a rooster’s head is given to her as an award.

4Obviously, the story is not true, but the festival is interesting.

高考英语3500词 · 11中文译文

一个有趣的节日

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1农事节在独立日之后举行。它并非世界各地都庆祝的节日。因为它的宗教渊源，只有墨西哥的基督徒盼着节日到来。

2很久以前，人类的祖先品行恶劣。他们互相欺骗、捉弄，答应过的事从来不算数。于是上帝现身，淹没了他们所有的庄稼。人们日夜挨饿，哭个不停。为了求得宽恕，一位女诗人出发去见上帝。她向上帝表示敬仰，一再道歉，终于打动了上帝。得到上帝的允许后，人们又迎来了好收成。为了忘掉悲伤，也为了提醒自己信奉上帝，人们便开始庆祝这个节日。

3节日当天，大家聚在操场、停车场等露天场所，兴致勃勃地玩上一整夜，像是不知疲倦。等一位穿着漂亮衣裳的女子朗诵诗歌，纪念那位女诗人时，所有人都屏住呼吸。随后，按习俗，人们会把一块公鸡头骨送给她作为奖赏。

4这显然只是一个传说，节日本身倒挺有意思。
